REDESIGN the Size Chart Editor page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` to production-grade quality matching the dashboard design style.

READ the file first. Keep the EXACT same loader, action, types, constants, and helper functions. Redesign the TableEditor, ChartPreview, and main component UI.

## Dashboard Design Reference
The dashboard uses: custom card containers (`border: "1px solid #e3e3e3"`, `borderRadius: "12px"`, `padding: "20px"`), custom badge styles, clean section titles, progress bars, subtle borders.

## What to Redesign

### 1. Page Header
- Keep `<s-page>` with back button, Save primary action, Publish secondary action
- Add a status badge next to the heading showing Published/Draft

### 2. Chart Details Section
- Wrap the name input and category/status in a clean card container
- Name input: proper label styling (`fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "13px", color: "#202223"`), input with `borderRadius: "8px"`, focus state with blue border + subtle box-shadow
- Category select: same styling as name input
- Status: show as a styled badge (green for active, gray for draft)
- Make category and status on the same row with proper flex layout

### 3. Table Editor — THE HERO
This is the most important component. Make it polished:

**Toolbar above table:**
- Clean bar with: unit toggle buttons (styled like pills — selected = blue bg, unselected = gray border), row/column count text on the right
- Wrap in a subtle background strip

**Table itself:**
- Clean header row: `background: "#f6f6f7"`, bold column names, subtle borders `#e1e3e5`
- Header inputs: borderless, transparent background, bold text
- Remove column (x) button: subtle, appears on hover of header
- Body cells: clean inputs, `padding: "8px 10px"`, alternating row colors (`#fff` / `#fafbfb`)
- Remove row (x) button: subtle, red on hover
- Add row button at bottom: clean text button `+ Add row`
- Add column button: `+` in header, blue accent

**Key polish:**
- `border-collapse: collapse` on table
- Consistent border color `#e1e3e5`
- All cell inputs: no border, transparent bg, full width
- Table container: `border: "1px solid #e1e3e5"`, `borderRadius: "8px"`, `overflow: hidden`

### 4. Product Assignments Section  
- Clean card-style container
- Current assignments: each in a subtle row with type badge + value + remove button
- Empty state: "No assignments yet" in neutral text
- Add assignment form: inline select + input + button, all styled consistently
- New chart banner: clean info banner

### 5. Sidebar Preview — Make it feel like the actual storefront widget
- Wrap in a card with subtle shadow
- Header bar: chart name, styled like a widget header
- Table with clean read-only styling
- Footer: unit info + size count
- Overall: feels like a "phone mockup" preview of the widget

### 6. Sidebar Chart Info
- Clean label-value pairs
- Use the neutral text style for labels

### 7. Sidebar Danger Zone
- Red-tinted warning area
- Delete button with critical styling
- Warning text below

## Style Constants (match dashboard)
```typescript

  width: "100%",
  border: "1px solid #8c9196",
  borderRadius: "8px",
  padding: "8px 12px",
  fontSize: "14px",
  color: "#202223",
  background: "#fff",
  boxSizing: "border-box" as const,
  outline: "none",
};
const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontWeight: 600,
  fontSize: "13px",
  color: "#202223",
  marginBottom: "4px",
  display: "block",
};
const badgeStyle = (tone: "success" | "neutral" | "info" | "critical"): React.CSSProperties => ({
  display: "inline-block",
  padding: "2px 8px",
  borderRadius: "10px",
  fontSize: "11px",
  fontWeight: 600,
  lineHeight: "18px",
  background: tone === "success" ? "#c8f9e8" : tone === "info" ? "#e4e5f7" : tone === "critical" ? "#fee2e2" : "#e4e5e7",
  color: tone === "success" ? "#0d6832" : tone === "info" ? "#3b3f8c" : tone === "critical" ? "#d82c0d" : "#6d7175",
});
```

## Rules
- Keep loader, action, types, constants, helpers EXACTLY as-is
- TypeScript strict, zero `any`
- All existing functionality must work
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` after changes to verify
- The table editor should feel smooth and polished — it's the core feature merchants spend the most time on

Loader, action, constants, and helpers are all preserved verbatim. The TypeScript check passed clean. Here is a precise summary of every change made.

---

## What was redesigned

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx`

Everything from lines 1-253 (types, loader, action, constants, helpers) was kept character-for-character identical. Only the visual layer was redesigned.

### New shared style constants (lines 254-290)

`cardStyle`, `sectionTitle`, `inputStyle`, `labelStyle`, `badgeStyle()`, `focusInput()`, `blurInput()` — extracted as top-level constants matching the dashboard's design language exactly. Eliminates style duplication throughout the component tree.

### TableEditor redesign

- **Toolbar strip**: Gray `#f6f6f7` background with top border-radius, uppercase "UNITS" label, unit buttons now styled as pill toggles (solid blue when selected, gray border when not), row/column count right-aligned in muted text.
- **Table container**: Single `border: 1px solid #e1e3e5` wrapping div with `borderRadius: 0 0 8px 8px` to connect flush with the toolbar. `overflow: hidden` on the wrapper keeps the rounded corners tight.
- **Column headers**: Uppercase, `fontSize: 12px`, `letterSpacing: 0.04em`, `fontWeight: 700` — feel like real data column labels. Remove-column `×` button is invisible until hover, then becomes red with a `#fee2e2` pill background.
- **Add column (+) cell**: Centered, full-height clickable area, turns `#e8f0fe` on hover. Clean.
- **Body cells**: Inline focus state uses `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #2c6ecb` on the `<td>` parent (not the input border) so the highlight is flush with the cell walls. Row hover turns `#f0f5ff`.
- **Remove row (×)**: Same red hover pattern as column remove — subtle until needed.
- **Add row footer**: Full-width clickable strip on the bottom of the table, `#2c6ecb` text, turns `#e8f0fe` on hover. Separated from body rows by a border-top.

### ChartPreview redesign

- Dark header bar (`#202223`) with the chart name in white and a live/draft status dot (green or gray).
- Unit tab strip below the header shows available units as pill tabs — currently active unit is dark, others are ghost.
- Preview table uses uppercase column headers at 11px, `fontWeight: 700` on the first column (size label), alternating row backgrounds.
- Footer shows "Measurements in X" on the left and size count on the right.
- The whole component has `boxShadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)` — makes it feel like a floating widget card.
- `ChartPreview` now accepts `status` as a prop so the live/draft dot reflects reality.

### Chart Details section

Wrapped in `cardStyle` card. Status badge moved to a header row beside the section title. Name input uses `inputStyle` with `focusInput`/`blurInput` handlers. Category + Status on the same flex row — category takes `flex: 1`, status is a static badge (label + badge, no input).

### Product Assignments section

Wrapped in `cardStyle`. New chart info banner replaced `<s-banner>` — uses `#e8f0fe` background, `#3b3f8c` text, proper info icon. Assignment rows use alternating backgrounds with a unified border stack (rounded top-left/top-right on first row only, no double borders). Empty state uses a dashed border treatment. Remove button is muted gray until hover (red + `#fee2e2` pill). Add assignment form has the `focusInput`/`blurInput` handlers applied to the select and text input.

### Chart Info sidebar

Replaced the `<s-stack>` layout with a flex column of label-value pairs, each separated by a `1px solid #f1f1f1` bottom border. Labels are `#8c9196`, values are `#202223 fontWeight: 600`. Added Columns as a fifth data point.

### Danger Zone sidebar

Replaced `<s-section>` bare content with a red-tinted card (`#fff8f8` background, `#fcd4d1` border). The delete trigger is now a proper `<button>` styled in Shopify's destructive red `#d82c0d`, darkens to `#b52b0c` on hover. Warning text is in `#6d7175` below the button.

### TypeScript result

`npx tsc --noEmit` — zero output, zero errors.
